selected_problem: Fresh main had aligned trailing-separator regular-file identity in changesets, federation and semantic graph, but WorkspaceService.contextBundle still preserved a trailing slash in selected path identity. The same real file could therefore be returned as src/a.js/ or src/a.js depending on the request spelling, and lexical path dedup occurred before that identity was canonicalized.
decision_basis: The gap is a narrow fresh-main consistency defect in repository-context identity, directly falsifiable without selecting a new context architecture.

contextBundle already performs lexical normalization before secret/type/identity checks, so trailing-separator collapse extends the same path-identity invariant now used by changeset, federated and semantic layers.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.
change: WorkspaceService.contextBundle removes trailing separators after POSIX lexical normalization and leading ./ removal, before seen-path dedup, credential filtering, extension classification and returned path receipts.

validation.filesystem_reality: PASS: on a temporary workspace the host resolved src/a.js and src/a.js/ to the same regular file.
validation.focused_replay: PASS: fresh-main normalization produced two lexical identities while proposed normalization converged both to src/a.js; requesting both aliases selected one canonical context path.

truth_boundary: This closes trailing-separator lexical identity drift at bounded workspace context selection. It does not claim filesystem case/Unicode equivalence, exhaustive repository coverage, parser-grade semantics, arbitrary I/O atomicity, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
